(2) White milk is then poured into the same glass, mixing with the cola to create a light brown beverage. (3) A young man with dark hair in a green shirt sits at a desk with a white keyboard and mouse, looking intently at a computer screen and then sighing as if tired. (4) A hand opens a refrigerator door, revealing various drinks; a bottle of cola is retrieved. (5) The man stands before a large, lit glass display cabinet packed with hundreds of figures, holding his glass of cola-milk and admiring the collection. (6) Close-up shots pan across detailed figures of characters like Frieza and Goku in various poses. (7) The man sits back at his desk, wearing wired earphones, and browses his smartphone while gesturing with his hands. (8) A white cartoon cat character with an angry facial expression appears as a full-screen graphic. (9) Screen captures of the Mercari mobile app interface are shown, displaying searches for Dragon Ball figures and various price listings in NTD. (10) The man talks directly to the camera, giving thumbs-up gestures and pointing, with the figure shelves behind him. (11) Text overlays with discount information appear over him. (12) A shot from inside a cardboard box shows the man opening the flaps and looking inside with a wide smile. (13) The man holds several large, boxed Dragon Ball figures, looking extremely happy and satisfied.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote the Mercari shopping app to Taiwanese anime collectors. It starts with a relatable lifestyle hook (drinking cola-milk to de-stress) and transitions into a common struggle for collectors: wanting rare Japanese merchandise without being able to travel there. It then positions Mercari as the ultimate 'otaku paradise' for buying new and second-hand items directly from Japan, highlighting specific promotional discounts.
